title: 2013 AMC 12A Problem 5
statement: Tom, Dorothy, and Sammy went on a vacation and agreed to split the costs evenly. During their trip Tom paid \(\$105,\) Dorothy paid \(\$125,\) and Sammy paid \(\$175.\) In order to share the costs equally, Tom gave Sammy \(t\) dollars, and Dorothy gave Sammy \(d\) dollars. What is \(t - d?\)

solutions.text:
The total spent was \(105 + 125 + 175 = 405,\) so each fair share is \(\tfrac13\cdot 405 = 135\) dollars.

Then \(t = 135 - 105 = 30\) and \(d = 135 - 125 = 10,\) so \(t - d = 30 - 10 = 20.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Each person’s fair share is one third of the total spent
\(t\) and \(d\) measure how much Tom and Dorothy each fall short of their fair share
